title: Patient Financial Account — Schedule C, Payment Methods, Allocation Order and Returned Items
content:
This schedule sets, for each financial class of the Patient Financial Account, the fee posted when a check or ACH payment is returned unpaid by the bank, the number of returned payments within the look-back after which check and ACH are no longer accepted, the rolling look-back in calendar months over which returned payments are counted (the check and ACH restriction then lasts the same number of months), whether HSA/FSA debit cards are accepted, and the order in which an undesignated payment is applied across open charges.

| Financial class (tier) | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Returned payments before restriction | Look-back and restriction (calendar months) | HSA/FSA card accepted | Allocation order of an undesignated payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | 0.00 | 2 | 12 | yes | oldest date of service first |
| Self-Pay Account | 30.00 | 2 | 12 | yes | oldest date of service first |
| Medicare Part B Account | 30.00 | 2 | 12 | yes | oldest date of service first |
| Medicare Advantage Account | 30.00 | 2 | 12 | yes | oldest date of service first |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | 30.00 | 2 | 12 | yes | oldest date of service first |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | 30.00 | 2 | 12 | yes | oldest date of service first |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | 30.00 | 2 | 12 | yes | oldest date of service first |

Notes:

1. The returned-payment fee is 30.00 on every class except the Medicaid Managed Care Account, where it is 0.00.
2. The restriction count of 2 returned payments and the look-back of 12 calendar months are the same on all seven classes.
3. HSA/FSA debit cards are accepted on every class, and every class applies an undesignated payment oldest date of service first.
